title: stellaria palustris f. minima
intro: Stellaria palustris f. minima, commonly known as Lesser Stitchwort, is a subspecies of the Stellaria palustris plant, a flowering perennial herb that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Stitchwort include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
